newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's phosphates output up in first half.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's phosphates output up in first half.

text.p: Tunisia's phosphates output during the first half of 1996 was 3.3 million tonnes, up by 12.7 percent from 2.8 million tonnes during the same period last year, officials said on Monday.
They said 2.8 million tonnes of the total were sold to the state-run Groupe Chimique in charge of manufacturing phosphates products for exports and the domestic market.
Raw phosphates exports during the first half of 1996 were 564,000 tonnes worth 16.4 million dinars, the officials said.
Tunisia is one of the world's major exporter of phosphates and by-products.
Tunisia's production of phosphates, a major foreign exchange earner, rose to 6.30 million tonnes in 1995 from 5.65 million in 1994.
The value of exports of raw phosphates and products rose 15 percent to 534.1 million dinars from 463.8 million dinars in 1994.
Official forecasts put raw phosphates production in 1996 at seven million tonnes.
Tunisia's reserves of phosphates are officially estimated at 350 million tonnes. ($=0.96 dinar)
